cells.gaps: The 2026 DPO regulations (MUS-002) come into operation on 1 January 2027, after the as-at, so they do not count as issued; the Fees Regulations 2020 do. No figures for 2025 have been found; the bill to amend the Act for EU adequacy is drafting, undated beyond 2024.
cells.note: Standing in-force (Data Protection Act 2017), Fees Regulations 2020 in force, and the Data Protection Office reports 2024 figures including 39 complaints closed and 112 transfers authorised or rejected, a year ending inside 24 months. MUS-010 (3,000 enforcement actions, no year) read as applied, MUS-008 and MUS-018 as activity; authority is constituted, so no cap.
